summary: One shot of three fails motion QC. The correction is that shot alone; approved references, plan and sibling shots survive verbatim.
prompt: A three-shot sequence has approved visual direction, an approved shot plan, and one approved reference frame per shot, each with approvedBy recorded. Shot SH02 fails detect-motion-artifacts with periodic seams; SH01 and SH03 are clean and selected. Plan the correction. List exactly which artifacts change and which are preserved unchanged, and name the command that performs the correction.
